claim: California's aggressive codification of extraterritorial application under SB 699 creates profound operational risks
evidence: These new laws raise significant issues of scope and extraterritoriality. It remains to be seen how broadly these new laws will apply in practice, and whether jurisdictional challenges may limit their effect.
